# Track 2 — the accepted drug ranking in BUB1B-related mosaic variegated aneuploidy

**GENERATED FILE — do not edit.** Rendered from a live triage run by

fails if this file and the generator disagree, so the page cannot drift away from the

**Nothing here is medical advice, and there is no dose on this page.** "Accepted" means
*this agent cleared every gate this pipeline applies*, on public literature about a
gene, with no patient data of any kind. It does not mean recommended, it does not mean
safe and it does not mean a treatment exists. The accepted agent is an **experimental
probe**: its direction of effect on BubR1 abundance has never been measured in any
genotype, so the first experiment measures that sign instead of testing a treatment.
Every row below is a research hypothesis requiring pre-clinical validation.

Source: `knowledge/literature/bub1b/` — mechanism `MECH-BUB1B-01`, gene BUB1B, catalogue
version `bub1b-literature-v1`.

The catalogue is **literature-curated**: every row cites a specific publication, listed
in `knowledge/literature/bub1b/SOURCES.md`. That is real pharmacology and it is not a
pharmacological database — it is one author's reading of the literature on one date,
with no completeness guarantee, so the absence of an agent is not evidence against it
(ADR 0022, GP-20).

## What the run produced

13 agents screened, 1 accepted, 12 rejected, 89 evidence rows, every rejection kept with
its reasons (GP-19). The rejections are rendered in full on
`docs/track2-drugs-to-avoid.md` from this same pass over these same tables under the
same fixed clock; this page is the accepting side of it.

## The accepted agent is not the highest-scoring one

Rank 1 scores 0.500 with an unsigned direction at the therapeutic target. The highest
score of the run is 0.605 and that agent — Nicotinamide mononucleotide — is
**rejected**. It is also the only one of the 13 whose direction at its node was measured
and found to agree.

Because approval status and an unassessed chromosomal-instability question are **gates**
rather than score terms, an agent can be right about the biology and still not be a
candidate (ADR 0011, ASSUMPTION-DRUG-07). A pipeline in which the top score always wins
has no way to say that sentence, and this run is the case that shows the gate firing:
the agent it stops is the one the ranking likes most.

The direction column is tri-state throughout and is never rounded (GP-16,
ASSUMPTION-DRUG-02). Of 13 agents, 1 was measured to move its node the right way, 5 were
measured to move it the wrong way, and 7 carry a direction nobody has measured. The
third group is neither of the first two.

**Do not read the rejected rows as a list of harmful agents.** 10 of the 12 rejections
have a blank chromosomal-instability cell: nobody ever asked whether they increase
aneuploidy. GP-14 — that is the absence of a finding, not a finding of harm. In this
disease an unasked question is disqualifying by design, which is a fact about the gate
and not about the agent. `docs/track2-drugs-to-avoid.md` separates the two cases agent
by agent.

## The accepted candidate (1)

Every mandatory question this pipeline asks is answered by a field below, including the
ones whose answer is "nobody has measured it". An incomplete hypothesis cannot be
constructed; a hypothesis that is complete and still unsigned at its target node can,
and this is one.

### Rank 1 — Nicotinic acid — `DRUG-NA`

- **Regulatory standing:** approval status `approved_other_indication`, approved name
  `nicotinic acid`, intervention class `disease_modifying`. Repurposing means
  redeploying an agent that already exists; this field is what makes the word
  applicable, and it says nothing about whether the agent works here.
- **Node acted on:** `N3_bubr1` — BubR1 protein abundance
- **Molecular target:** NAD+ pool via the Preiss-Handler pathway
- **Required correction:** `increase` — **observed:** `unknown` — **verdict:** cannot
  determine (unsigned)
- **Score:** 0.500 of 1, carrying an unsigned direction at the node it acts on. The
  score ranks hypotheses against each other inside one run. It is not a probability, not
  a strength of evidence and not a recommendation.
- **Chromosomal-instability question:** measured — no (other population). The
  chromosomal-instability question was asked and came back negative — in adults, a
  population that is not this one. That closes the gate and is not a clean bill of
  health: a negative measured elsewhere is not a measurement here (ADR 0011,
  ASSUMPTION-DRUG-06). Micronucleus frequency for this agent on a BUB1B-deficient
  background remains unmeasured, and the first experiment reads it out rather than
  deferring it to a later study.
- **Evidence:** strongest tier `human_trial`, and it is **indirect** — no measurement of
  this agent on this target in a relevant system. The tier and the directness are
  separate fields and both are printed, because the tier alone reads as strength it does
  not have here: a human trial is the highest tier this catalogue records, and this one
  was not run on this target, in this disease, or in this population.
- **Recorded concerns (2, none fatal):** `pharmacokinetic_barrier`, `direction_unknown`.
  An accepted hypothesis must leave `rejection_reasons` empty, so these live in a field
  of their own instead of being discarded — "accepted despite this" is the sentence a
  reviewer needs and the one a bare rank hides.
  - `pharmacokinetic_barrier` — Exposure relative to the effective concentration cannot
    be computed, because one of the two figures has never been recorded.
    `concentration_achievable` is therefore `None` and stays `None`: the gap is kept as
    a concern rather than resolved optimistically (ASSUMPTION-DRUG-05). An agent that
    works in culture at a concentration the body never reaches is not a therapy, and
    nothing on this page can tell you which case this is.
  - `direction_unknown` — The direction this agent pushes the target has never been
    measured. Recorded as a flag and a score penalty, never as agreement and never as a
    wrong-direction rejection: `directions_agree` is tri-state and `None` is neither end
    of it (GP-16, ASSUMPTION-DRUG-02). This is the concern the first experiment exists
    to retire.
- **Safety signals carried (none disqualifying):** `SC-DRUG-NA-CONC-UNKNOWN` (major,
  Any); `SC-DRUG-NA-CNS` (moderate, Patients with a CNS phenotype)
  - `SC-DRUG-NA-CONC-UNKNOWN` — Achievable and/or required concentration for Nicotinic
    acid is not recorded, so it is unknown whether the mechanism can be reached in vivo.
  - `SC-DRUG-NA-CNS` — The phenotype is neurological and Nicotinic acid is of unknown
    CNS penetration. Target engagement in the affected tissue is unestablished.
- **What a first experiment here can and cannot establish:** The agent acts on the
  therapeutic target and nobody has measured which way it moves it. That is what makes
  it a probe rather than a candidate, and it fixes what the first experiment is for:
  measuring the sign, not trying a treatment. The readout that decides the hypothesis is
  whether BubR1 abundance moves at all, and in which direction, in cells carrying the
  patient's genotype — an experiment built that way is informative whichever way it
  comes out, and one that assumed the sign would be informative only if it guessed
  right. The agent is here because the question is answerable, not because the answer is
  known.
- **The experiment that comes first, in the pipeline's own words:** Confirm NAPRT
  expression in the target cell type FIRST, by immunoblot or targeted mass spectrometry
  against an NAPRT-null control, because nicotinic acid cannot reach the NAD+ pool of a
  cell that lacks the Preiss-Handler entry enzyme and a null result downstream would
  then be uninterpretable. Then measure intracellular NAD+, BubR1 K668 acetylation,
  total BubR1 and the blinded missegregation rate in BUB1B-MVA patient fibroblasts
  across the plasma NAD+ elevations already documented in humans, with a SIRT2-knockdown
  arm for mechanism specificity, an ectopic-BubR1 arm as the ceiling, and a high-dose
  nicotinamide arm as the counter-directional control. Micronucleus frequency in a
  BUB1B-deficient background remains unmeasured for this agent and is a readout of the
  same experiment, not a separate study.

## Where the score comes from

The four weights below are module constants in `src/mva/interventions/generate.py`, read
by this page rather than retyped into it. They are documented heuristics, not calibrated
parameters: changing one requires a decision record, a test and a before/after
comparison (GP-32).

| Term | Weight | What it asks |
|---|---|---|
| Direction | 0.40 | Does the agent push the node the way the mechanism requires? |
| Evidence | 0.30 | How far is the evidence from a demonstrated human outcome? |
| Safety | 0.20 | What did the safety pass find, weighted by severity? |
| Approval | 0.10 | Is the agent actually available to redeploy? |

Direction carries the largest single weight, and an agent whose direction is unmeasured
collects 0.35 of that term — `DIRECTION_UNKNOWN_CREDIT`, the fraction retained when
agreement is undeterminable. Well below 1.0 because an unknown is never an agreement,
and well above 0.0 because an unknown is not a disagreement either (GP-14, GP-16). That
is the term the first experiment would move.

## What "accepted" does not mean

- **Not a recommendation and not a dose.** This pipeline models no exposure a patient
  would receive. It reads public literature about a gene and ranks research hypotheses;
  prescribing is outside everything it does.
- **Not a measured direction.** `unknown` is not agreement. It is a flag and a score
  penalty, and the hypothesis survives carrying it (GP-16, ASSUMPTION-DRUG-02). Reading
  rank 1 as "this raises BubR1" states a result nobody has produced.
- **Not a clean bill of health.** The chromosomal-instability gate is closed on a
  negative measured in another population, which is enough to clear a gate and not
  enough to support a claim (ASSUMPTION-DRUG-06).
- **Not unblemished.** The recorded concerns above are the pipeline's own near misses,
  kept rather than discarded. Accepted means not disqualified.
- **One context only.** The ranking scores the soma. An agent's direction can be
  desirable in the tumour and harmful in every other tissue of the same child, so a
  rejection here is not a verdict on tumour-directed use and this acceptance is not a
  verdict on it either (ASSUMPTION-DRUG-08).
